item.title: Replace order status strings with OrderStatus
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate to use a proper typed order status, preserving all observable behavior. Add src/status.rs with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement `as_str(self) -> &'static str` mapping to lowercase names, Display with the same output, FromStr with `type Err = ParseStatusError` where the public error implements std::error::Error and its message names the rejected input, and `can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` allowing exactly pending→paid, pending→cancelled, paid→shipped, paid→cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root. Use the enum throughout the crate, so the four lowercase status string literals appear only in src/status.rs (including production code; preserve current report parsing/error behavior and output/order). Keep current tests passing and add or adapt coverage for parsing, formatting, transition rules, and error input. Run `cargo test` in the worktree. Commit the completed changes as requested by the operator. Acceptance: cargo test passes; all existing observable behavior including error text, report output/order, and parsing stays the same; only src/status.rs contains those status-name literals.

stages.summary:
Baseline/characterization complete for the OrderStatus refactor. Structural goal: replace Order.status String with a public typed OrderStatus, expose ParseStatusError, and centralize the four status-name literals while preserving observable behavior. Original baseline: 8113a5b9e7042807c360c8679905c8662e7a61e1. Added characterization tests only in tests/orders.rs and committed separately as d9145a155d00e0fdf59bf68e3f0384e803476723; no production files changed. The worktree is clean on archon/m6w99vq6-replace-order-status-strings-with-orders.

Checks: before edits, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mengsig/.local/share/archon-bench/f164-ezf9wwc6/archon-bench/work/20261120T123040Z/c3bc0bab30d9f4386fe9d90e/.archon/data/cache/refactor-order-status/items/qi_01M7WGS8BQNQN58ADCM6W99VQ6/cargo-target cargo test` passed (3 integration tests). After tests, the same command passed (5 integration tests). No README, CONTRIBUTING guide, Makefile, CI config, or AGENTS.md was present in the searched workspace; Cargo.toml identifies a standalone Rust 2021 crate. The last checked tree is 71a775bf6591eb2b6231b8470597781912e087c4.

Coverage now pins lifecycle output/state, illegal payment/shipping messages, status counts and sorting, outstanding totals, ready-to-ship input order, report serialization/round-trip, whole-line trimming, exact unknown-status and wrong-field-count errors, and failed cancellation's exact message and unchanged state. Existing test coverage did not directly pin those report failure details or shipped cancellation behavior; enum parsing/Display/transition behavior cannot be tested until implementation and remains for refactor/verifier stages. Public surface to preserve: `Order::{new,is_open,cancel}` and public fields `id`, `customer`, `total_cents`, `status`; `billing::{pay,outstanding_cents}`, `shipping::{ship,ready_to_ship}`, and `report::{status_counts,to_line,from_line}`. Current report format is `id,customer,total_cents,status`, sorted status-count output is lexicographic, and report parser trims the entire line then requires exactly four comma-separated fields and exact known status spelling. Required signature change is `Order.status: OrderStatus`; crate-root enum/error re-exports are new surface. Only explicitly allowed contract changes are those required by this requested typed status API; no behavior changes were authorized. No feedback was supplied.

Implemented and committed the typed OrderStatus refactor. Added the public enum, parsing error, formatting, and transition rules; changed order lifecycle and reporting code to use the enum while retaining report parsing behavior and existing error/output text. `cargo test` passed (3 unit and 5 integration tests). Characterization commit d9145a1 and baseline 8113a5b remain unchanged. Commit: 2cd38a6c41a3bb03681bec1ec0727bf5d78bdf7b; worktree clean. Existing tests were not modified. No feedback findings were supplied.

pr.body: Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus, ParseStatusError, FromStr, Display, as_str, and the specified transition matrix. Re-exported the public types at crate root and converted order, billing, shipping, and report code to use OrderStatus. Report parsing still trims the whole line, accepts exact known spellings, and returns the characterized errors. Verified with cargo test (3 unit and 5 integration tests passed) and git diff --check. The inherited characterization tests and baseline commit were unchanged. Whole-crate cargo fmt --check reports formatting differences in pre-existing tests/orders.rs and baseline formatting; changed production Rust files were formatted. No known open implementation work.
